summary: End-to-end verification of the new online appointment scheduling feature on the Smart Card (admin toggles + availability, public booking flow with .ics, double-book prevention, owner /citas page with NEW badge + drawer call/message/view-client, CRM + Calendar side effects, and the regression on Let's-Connect / Request-Quote toggles). BACKEND (pytest 12/12 PASS, JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_36_appointments.xml): availability shape (enabled, duration=60, weekdays Mon-Fri only, slots non-empty), POST booking happy path returns confirmed appointment with no _id and produces (a) a client in /api/clients and (b) a job in /api/jobs with source='appointment', scheduled_date/start_time/end_time set; 409 on double-book, slot removed from next availability call; 400 validations for missing name / past date / invalid HH:MM; GET /api/appointments owner-scoped with new_count, returns viewed=false for fresh booking, POST /appointments/{id}/viewed flips viewed=true; PUT /api/card/settings toggles request_estimate_enabled false/true and the public /api/public/card/{slug} reflects it. FRONTEND (Playwright on mobile 390x844): regression - card-connect AND card-request-quote present alongside card-schedule; card-schedule opens the bottom-sheet booking modal (booking-dates renders; bookTitle text 'Book an appointment / Agenda una cita' visible). Booked the 2026-06-25 16:00 slot dynamically chosen from /availability — booking-success appeared with booking-add-calendar button; clicking it triggered a real .ics download (appointment.ics captured by Playwright). Reopened the modal: the 16:00 chip was gone (double-book UI-level confirmed). Owner /citas page: appointments-page testid present; 3 appt-card-* cards rendered; 2 appt-new-dot badges shown; opened a NEW card -> bottom drawer ('Detalle de la cita') exposed appt-call (href=tel:5557779999), appt-message (href=sms:5557779999), appt-view-client; after closing, the red dot on that card disappeared (POST /appointments/{id}/viewed). CRM: /clientes shows the freshly booked 'QA Book 1782337405' client. CardAdmin /tarjeta step-appt accordion: all three toggles (toggle-lets_connect_enabled, toggle-request_estimate_enabled, toggle-appt_enabled), 7 weekday chips appt-day-0..6 with Lun/Mar/Mié/Jue/Vie pre-selected, 4 duration chips appt-dur-30/60/90/120 with 60 active, plus appt-start (09:00) and appt-end (17:00) inputs persisted as expected. Citas nav item exists for owner (label 'Appointments', href '/citas', surfaced inside the More menu on mobile). No critical bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: The backdrop <div> has onClick={onClose} (SmartCard.js:1206) which causes a bubbled click from the trigger button (Playwright force=True or programmatic dispatch on document) to immediately close the modal. The inner wrapper has stopPropagation, but if a parent click handler ever fires before the modal mounts, the experience can feel inconsistent. Real user taps work fine; only force/synthetic events are affected.

issues: Top language banner '¿Hablas español? Mira UniTech en tu idioma' still shows on /citas even when owner is logged in and language already EN — minor UX nit (banner dismiss flag should likely also be honoured here).

action_items: Consider exposing the 'Citas / Appointments' link as a first-class bottom-nav tab (currently only reachable from the More menu) since it has a NEW dot UX that benefits from being visible at all times.
(Optional polish) Add a data-testid='booking-title' to the BookingForm header div so tests can wait on the title without relying on text content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4279 uses 'if d <= _date.today()' for past-date validation. This is local server-date based; the comment says 'bookable from tomorrow' which is enforced in availability. Good defensive guard, but a client in a +12 hr timezone could theoretically be denied a valid same-day slot. Acceptable per spec (times handled as local wall-clock).

server.py:4286-4290 double-book check uses {date, start_time, status!=cancelled} but does NOT include card_id — if a user ever has multiple cards on the same account, two different cards would share the same calendar lock. Owner has a single card today so it's safe; add card_id to the unique index if multi-card-per-user is ever supported.
server.py:4317 insert_appointment then returns appt; appt.pop('_id', None) is called AFTER insert (line 4318) — good, no Mongo ObjectId leaks. Verified in tests.

SmartCard.js:1206 the modal root has onClick={onClose}; combined with force=True clicks this can synthetically close the modal. Not a user-facing bug but worth noting for E2E test stability — using e.target===e.currentTarget guard would be more robust.
Appointments.js opens the drawer and POSTs /appointments/{id}/viewed on open — verified that the NEW dot clears on the in-memory list. No re-fetch needed thanks to optimistic update.
BookingForm 'addToCalendar' uses a client-side ICS string + anchor download. Captured by Playwright as a real download (filename appointment.ics). No backend route required.
Public availability endpoint correctly caps days at 60 and starts from tomorrow (line 4239) — protects against past-date bookings cleanly.

These can be cleaned up by deleting from db.appointments / db.clients / db.jobs where name like 'TEST_Booking_%' or 'QA Book %'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Appointments fixture state on uni2-marketing-agency: appt_enabled=true, Mon-Fri (appt_days=[0,1,2,3,4]), 09:00-17:00, 60 min slots. As of this run, slots booked include 2026-06-25 10:00 (legacy), 2026-06-25 11:00 (pytest TEST_Booking), and 2026-06-25 16:00 (Playwright QA Book) — so /availability for 2026-06-25 currently returns only 12:00/13:00/14:00/15:00. Always read /api/public/card/{slug}/availability before booking to avoid 409. /api/auth/login returns {token, user} (NOT access_token); JSON-token key is 'token'. The /citas Citas nav lives inside More menu on mobile widths. CardAdmin step-appt accordion testids: toggle-lets_connect_enabled, toggle-request_estimate_enabled, toggle-appt_enabled, appt-day-0..6, appt-start, appt-end, appt-dur-30/60/90/120. BookingForm modal does NOT have a data-testid on the title node; wait on [data-testid='booking-dates'] instead. Use real click() on card-schedule, NOT force=True (the backdrop's onClick=onClose intercepts the synthetic bubble).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. Two minor observations (modal backdrop onClick can interfere with force-clicks in E2E; double-book unique index does not include card_id) are documented in critical_code_review_comments.
